title: POC activation and success metrics - Montara Energy
content:
Objective:
Run a 4-week technical POC with Montara Energy to validate that Redwood Inference can deliver predictable, low-latency document understanding and conversational assistance for field ops while meeting cost and security constraints. This doc defines the activation checklist, measurable success criteria, test dataset, workshop agenda, technical assumptions, and sign-off process.

Customer context and problem statement:
Montara Energy operates distributed field crews that process maintenance logs and safety reports. They want: (1) a searchable embeddings layer for historical notes, (2) a lightweight chat assistant for on-device troubleshooting that references internal SOPs, and (3) a reranking pipeline to surface highest-confidence incident reports. Current pain points: slow manual search, high time-to-resolution, risk of misapplied procedures.

POC scope (4 weeks):
- Inference features: embeddings for search, chat completions with tool-calling (SOP retrieval), reranking for top-N incident results.
- Deployment mode: Hosted API for rapid validation, optional Dedicated trial in week 3 if throughput requires.
- Data: 10k anonymized maintenance reports + 500 SOP documents supplied by Montara.
- Exclusions: model training/fine-tuning, production data sharing outside staged dataset.

Success metrics (must be met for technical sign-off):
1) Latency and throughput
   - p95 inference latency for single-turn chat (hosted): <= 350 ms for under 512 tokens (including network time measured from synthetic client in US-West)
   - Throughput baseline: sustain 40 requests/second for embeddings ingestion during bulk load window without errors
2) Quality
   - Retrieval recall@10 for embeddings search: >= 0.78 on provided evaluation set (measured on 1k QA pairs)
   - Chat-grounded accuracy: 85% of sampled assistant responses are rated correct/complete by Montara SME rubric (50 sampled prompts)
   - Reranking lift: Top-1 precision improvement >= 18% vs Montara baseline heuristic ranker on incident dataset
3) Cost and efficiency
   - Estimated per-1000-token generation cost projected by Redwood Optimize: <= $0.65 for production-hosted profile or clear path to meet with Dedicated/quantized profile
4) Security and compliance
   - Customer confirms VPC peering and KMS integration requirements documented and acceptable
   - No PII leakage observed in 150 automated redaction checks across ingested docs
5) Reliability
   - Error rate < 0.5% during test windows and graceful fallback behavior validated (model variant fallback triggers and logging)

Acceptance criteria (PR lists):
- Tech validation: Engineering demo reproduces embedding search and chat flows end-to-end with Montara test app and passes the quality thresholds above.
- Ops validation: Console shows per-route latency and token breakdown; cost projection report exported and reviewed.
- Security validation: Network tests, KMS key exchange, and audit log entries reviewed by Montara security contact.

Technical prerequisites (customer + Redwood):
- Customer provides anonymized dataset (S3 link) and a small evaluation set (1k Q/A pairs) by 2025-10-08.
- Montara agrees to open outbound to Redwood API endpoints and/or set up VPC peering (ip-range and contact: montara-net-admin@montara.io).
- If Dedicated is requested: sample GPU profile requirements and expected concurrency details by week 2.
- Team access: a Montara SME contact (ops lead), API credentials for test accounts, and an engineer for integration pairing sessions.

Workshop and activation plan (week-by-week):
Week 0 (Prep, 3 days)
- Confirm dataset transfer, access, and redaction checklist.
- Kickoff workshop (90 min) with stakeholders to align scope and success metrics.
Week 1 (Ingest + baseline)
- Bulk ingestion of embeddings, initial search index validated.
- Baseline metrics collected (current search recall).
- Integration pairing: implement chat call that queries SOP store.
Week 2 (Iterate + quality testing)
- Run sampled evaluation set against embeddings and reranker.
- Tune prompt templates and system messages; test function/tool calling flows.
Week 3 (Scale + optional Dedicated trial)
- Load testing to target throughput, evaluate Dedicated run if needed.
- Resilience exercises: simulated region outage and fallback to alternate model variant.
Week 4 (Sign-off + handoff)
- Final demo with Montara stakeholders, deliver cost projection, runbook, and next-steps proposal.
- Compile executive summary and retention of logs/artifacts for audit.

Workshop agenda (Kickoff 90 min):
- 0:00–0:10 Introductions, objectives, success metrics (owner: Ava Chen)
- 0:10–0:25 Customer context & dataset walkthrough (owner: Montara ops lead)
- 0:25–0:45 Technical architecture and integration options (hosted, dedicated, private) (owner: Diego Martinez)
- 0:45–1:00 Demo of reference flows (embeddings search + chat + reranker) (owner: Solutions Eng)
- 1:00–1:15 Security & compliance checklist (owner: Priya Kapoor)
- 1:15–1:30 Timeline, responsibilities, immediate next actions (owner: Ava Chen)

Roles and responsibilities:
- Redwood (Solutions Eng, SE lead: Ava Chen) — POC orchestration, integration support, metric collection, runbook draft.
- Redwood (Infra/Platform: Diego Martinez) — hosting config, optional Dedicated sizing, monitoring hooks.
- Redwood (Security: Priya Kapoor) — KMS and audit log onboarding.
- Montara (Ops lead: Elena Ruiz) — provide datasets, SME validation, integration engineer for pairing.

Risks and mitigation:
- Data quality risk: if anonymization strips critical context, we will request a redaction-tolerant sample and run fallback synthetic augmentation.
- Throughput risk: if hosted endpoint cannot meet concurrency, plan Dedicated trial with quantized model profiles; pre-approved budget contingency required.
- Compliance risk: remote auditing window scheduled and a 48-hour pause for any unresolved data handling questions.

Logging and artifacts to deliver:
- Per-route latency/cost dashboard snapshot (CSV)
- Embedding evaluation report (recall/precision)
- Sampled chat transcripts and SME ratings (50 examples)
- Runbook: integration steps, fallback policies, escalation paths

Sign-off and next steps:
- Target sign-off meeting scheduled for 2025-11-01.
- Required sign-off from: Montara Ops Lead (Elena Ruiz), Montara Security (Rajiv Menon), Redwood SE Lead (Ava Chen), Redwood Security (Priya Kapoor).
- If success criteria met: propose 90-day pilot for Dedicated deployment and pricing estimate.

Immediate actions (within 48 hours):
- Montara: upload anonymized dataset to S3 and share link.
- Redwood: schedule kickoff workshop and create evaluation tracking sheet.
- Set up shared Slack channel: #poc-montara (owners: Ava Chen, Elena Ruiz).

Notes and open questions:
- Which SOP documents are considered controlled? Need classification to determine redaction strategy.
- Does Montara want transcripts stored beyond the POC window? Define retention policy now.
- If offline device use is required for field assistants, we need to scope a private deployment option separately.
